items.difficulty_reason: The lemma collects four statements about the canonical map from the filtered colimit of the global sections of a filtered diagram of sheaves of sets into the global sections of its colimit: injectivity under injective transition maps, injectivity over a quasi-compact topos, bijectivity when both hold, and bijectivity under an additional hypothesis on a set of objects of the topos (statement lines 3731-3760). The proof treats each part: part (1) via separated presheaves and the plus construction (proof lines 3763-3772); part (2) by forming the equalizers of two compatible families and using that the equalizer of the colimit maps is the filtered colimit of the stagewise equalizers together with quasi-compactness of the final sheaf (proof lines 3775-3793); part (3) by pulling the stages back along a map into the colimit and using quasi-compactness (proof lines 3797-3802); and part (4) by producing a quasi-compact object surjecting onto the final sheaf, factoring a lift through finitely many stages, and repeating the equalizer argument for its square (proof lines 3805-3869). The non-formal content is the equalizer bookkeeping with the quasi-compactness input. The claim is H2: several written-out arguments with each input named.
